Who’s doing the work

One crew.
No middlemen.

Green Man’s Contracting & Landscaping is a Greater Hartford outdoor-property company built around a simple idea: the person who quotes the job should be the person who shows up to do it.

The short version

Ray built this
on repeat calls.

Green Man’s runs on word of mouth — homeowners who called once for a cleanup and kept calling for the plow route, the fence repair, the next spring’s mulch. [FOUNDING STORY DETAILS] shaped how the company operates today: answer the phone, quote it straight, do the work well enough that nobody needs a second contractor.

That’s still the whole model. No call centre, no sales team, no subcontractors bidding down the job. Just a crew that covers landscaping, contracting and snow removal for the same properties, season after season.
